neutral_lenses.instruction: Try a direct or constructive approach. Build the claimed object, algorithm, strategy, or proof explicitly, and verify every required case. Preserve correct prior progress while making a genuinely new attempt in this direction.
neutral_lenses.name: direct_constructive

neutral_lenses.instruction: Try an obstruction, counterexample, or lower-bound approach. Identify the strongest obstruction allowed by the statement, test the boundary cases, and use the result either to prove the target or to establish a precise necessary limitation.
neutral_lenses.name: obstruction_counterexample_lower_bound

neutral_lenses.instruction: Try a structural reformulation, reduction, dual viewpoint, invariant, or decomposition. Translate the target into an equivalent intermediate statement and prove every step needed to transfer the conclusion back.
neutral_lenses.name: structural_reformulation_reduction
